text:
liam (support): heads-up: acme-prod reported a ~15min window of 429s + 500ms+ p95 on dedicated cluster during the morning ramp (08:15-08:30 UTC). customer ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TICKET-4621. they said they saw many requests queue and then immediate 429s. logs attached: `rate_limiter: throttle=1, target=warmpool`

metric-bot: escalation ticket created TICKET-4621, priority=P2 :rotating_light:

sophia (customer-success): customer reporting retries increased client-side error rates, they've routed traffic through fallback but want root cause and mitigation. said impact ~10% of requests timed out, some manual retries failed. :eyes:

ravi (eng-platform): looking at autoscaler telemetry now. initial observation: autoscaler did not scale past min_replicas for that pool for ~5 minutes, even while pending_queue was high. headroom metric stayed at 0. pulling metrics: `available_replicas=0`, `pending_spawns=18`, `imagepull_backoff=0.2s`

anya (eng-runtime): can you paste the allocator logs? I'm suspecting warmpool reconciliation flake. we had a metrics-collector restart yesterday; maybe label parsing regressed.

liam (support): paste from customer's service logs (redacted):
```
[08:16:02] request_id=abc123 status=429 route=/generate reason="no-ready-replicas"
[08:16:10] request_id=abc345 status=429 reason="warm-pool-miss"
[08:20:01] request_id=abc999 status=200 latency=420ms
```

ravi (eng-platform): found something weird in metrics-collector output. warmpool exporter emitted `ready_replicas: 8` for a moment, then a leader election caused index reset and emitted `ready_replicas: 0` while pods were still in ContainerCreating. autoscaler uses the time-series from collector to compute delta; during that period it concluded no additional capacity was needed (race with pending_spawns logic). basically stale zero reading masked the real pending state.

ravi (eng-platform): logs snippet from metrics-collector:
```
2026-03-18T08:15:58Z INFO warmpool/exporter ready_replicas=8
2026-03-18T08:16:01Z WARN leader-election: lost lock, reinit index
2026-03-18T08:16:02Z INFO warmpool/exporter ready_replicas=0
2026-03-18T08:16:05Z INFO warmpool/exporter pending_spawns=18
```

anya (eng-runtime): ah ok. that matches a known edgecase where a `lost lock -> reinit` path emits zero before reconciling actual pod states. autoscaler treats `ready_replicas` as authoritative if recent. combined with a short smoothing window we under-provisioned. this is different from imagepull/backoff.

matt (eng-sre): customer impact timeline: 08:15:58 - 08:21:10 elevated 429s while pods came up. fallback routing helped but not complete. we've already contacted customer with an interim note.

sophia (customer-success): they asked for short-term mitigation and long-term fix. short-term: they want guarantees for next-day scheduled jobs.

ravi (eng-platform): short-term mitigations: 1) bump min_replicas for acme-prod dedicated namespace to 3 (avoids complete zero hysteresis). 2) temporarily extend autoscaler smoothing window to ignore a single zero spike. 3) enable the fallback-region routing for higher-priority routes. I'd prefer 1+3 immediately.

liam (support): I'll ask ops to apply bump to min_replicas=3 now if you confirm.

matt (eng-sre): applying min_replicas bump to acme-prod namespace now. running: `kubectl -n dedicated-acme patch hpa acme-gen --type='json' -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":3}]'` :thumbsup:

infra-bot: patch applied by matt at 2026-03-18T08:22:10Z. new_min=3

ravi (eng-platform): follow-up: I'll push a fix to metrics-collector to avoid emitting zero on leader reinit (guard against transient). small patch landing in canary in 30m.

anya (eng-runtime): rollout plan: canary metrics-collector -> monitor warmpool exporter for 1h -> promote. also adding a defensive check in autoscaler: if pending_spawns > threshold and ready_replicas suddenly drops to 0 within 10s, treat as noisy reading and prefer pending_spawns signal. will open PR.

liam (support): repro steps for internal test harness (sharing with eng):
```
# simulate ramp and leader reinit
kubectl exec -n test-client -- ab -n 2000 -c 80 http://dedicated-acme.example/v1/generate
# kill leader pod to force reinit
kubectl delete pod -n metrics metrics-collector-0
```

ravi (eng-platform): confirmed repro on staging. created ticket INFRA-813 for the autoscaler change and METRICS-129 for collector fix. linking to TICKET-4621.

sophia (customer-success): customer notified of mitigations: bumped min_replicas and enabled regional fallback. they asked for postmortem and ETA for permanent fix.

liam (support): next steps:
- engineering to merge metrics-collector patch (ravi) - target: 2026-03-18T12:00 UTC
- autoscaler defensive guard PR (anya) - target: 2026-03-19
- keep acme min_replicas=3 for 72h and monitor token-level latency/cost

anya (eng-runtime): will post status here when canary looks green.

matt (eng-sre): monitoring dashboards updated, adding alert for `ready_replicas==0 && pending_spawns>5` to detect recurrence.

liam (support): thanks everyone. closing in 2h unless customer sees further issues. :white_check_mark:
